officialSources.observation: Official Bihar BhuNaksha portal describes digitized cadastral maps. Its live public selector was followed to East Champaran 02 → Chakia 04 → Mehsi circle 16 and city-named Mauzas Main Mehsi 0734, Kasba Mehsi 0737, and Purani Mehsi 0730. Client traces expose map-info and WMS routes; no full parcel vector was verified.
Official Mauja-wise report indexes East Champaran circle/village records including Mehsi. This establishes local record indexing only, not geospatial coverage at the WUP point.

requests.observation: Official viewer live UI resolved East Champaran district 02 → Chakia subdivision 04 → Mehsi circle 16 → Main Mehsi Mauza 0734 → Cadastral Survey (CS) → CS Map 06 → sheet 00. This is a named local cadastral map independent of the WUP centroid.

Official selected Main Mehsi CS sheet response: EPSG:32645; xmin 312447.31749583624; ymin 2916320.83622262; xmax 313785.41989247856; ymax 2918241.180299062; gisCode CS02041607341400600. Bounds are ordered and valid. Attribution identifies Mehsi circle, Mauza Main Mehsi(140), Cadastral Survey, CS Map, sheet 00.

The request used the exact midpoint of the valid official EPSG:32645 extent as an interior local validation point: x=313116.3686941574, y=2917281.00826084. The official plot-identify route returned `id=3ZLTxJhdQLS-B6ve_aHBmQ`, `kide=335`; no owner/name/address fields were requested or retained. This establishes map/plot identification, not a full polygon response.

Official viewer client inspection confirms plot-identify calls `rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY`, then renders selected and same-owner plots with WMS image layers (`PLOT_LIST`/`SAME_OWNER_PLOT_LIST`) and calls ScalarDatahandler for attributes. The client advertises no full-polygon, GeoJSON, or WFS route; WMS is raster imagery, so no geometry was counted.

Earlier bounded extent checks for Kasba Mehsi revisional sheets 01–04, Purani Mehsi revisional sheet 00, and Purani Mehsi cadastral sheets 01–02 returned EPSG:32645 extents with easting around 311–313 km. Some responses were malformed; the valid Purani/Kasba extents were about 24–26 km west of the WUP point. Those checks do not affect Main Mehsi CS sheet 00's valid local map extent or its selected plot response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: No citywide polygon scope is claimed. A local, named Main Mehsi cadastral sheet and one plot-identify result are verified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official Main Mehsi CS Map sheet 00 has a valid EPSG:32645 extent; its extent midpoint resolves to one local plot identifier through the advertised official identify route. The resulting visualization is WMS only; no full parcel polygon was retrieved.

research.technicalBlocker: The Bihar viewer’s map-identify workflow requires a selected map extent and plot-identify coordinate; the observed map display uses WMS. The available evidence did not resolve the WUP point to the precise Mauza/sheet or expose a full-vector parcel response, so no parcel query was counted as verified.
research.remainingUncertainty: Whether the WUP point falls within the Mehsi Mauza map coverage; which circle/subdivision and sheet apply at that coordinate; availability of any public full-polygon vector export behind the map viewer.
